spans.s:
वैमात्र m. (-त्रः) A step-mother's son.
 f. (-त्रा-त्री) A step-mother's daughter.
E. वि different, मातृ a mother, and अण् aff.

वैमात्रेय m. (-यः) A step-mother's son.
 f. (-यी) A half-sister, or one by
a different mother.
 E. विमातृ, ढक् aff.

वैमानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to a heavenly car, borne in one, &c.
 E. विमान, ठक् aff.

वैमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Liberated, emancipated, being at liberty or
loose.
 n. (-क्तं) Liberation.
 E. विमुक्त free, loose, अण् aff., implying
property or possession.

वैमुख्य n. (-ख्यं)
 1. Turning away the face.
 2. Flight, retreat.
 E. विमुख, ष्यञ् aff.

वैमेय m. (-यः) Barter, exchange.
 E. वि, मेङ् to barter, यत् aff., अण् added.
